name: Figma CLI plan access token
description: A plan access token of the Figma CLI category, with a fixed scope set for supported Figma CLI workflows; it is not a general-purpose REST API token.

blockers.summary: Figma states no prefix, alphabet, length or carrier for a Figma CLI token, and does not say it differs in form from a REST API plan token.
The token's string form would need a token generated in a Figma organization, which is not done here.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
